P.name: Icathian Surprise
P.title: Template:Data Kog'Maw/Icathian Surprise
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Icathian Surprise|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Kog'Maw
|skill        = I
|icon         = Icathian Surprise.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} Upon {{tip|death|dying}}, {{ci|Kog'Maw}} enters an {{tip|untargetable}} {{tip|zombie state}} for a few seconds, gradually gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. He explodes at the end of the duration, dealing {{as|true damage}} to nearby enemies.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} Upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Kog'Maw''' enters a {{tip|zombie state}} for 4 seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that increases up to {{as|50%|MS}} over the duration. At the end of the duration, he explodes to deal {{sti|true damage|{{as|{{pplevel|140 to 650}} true damage}}}} to nearby enemies.
|description2= While under this state, '''Kog'Maw''' becomes {{tip|invulnerability|invulnerable}}, {{tip|untargetable}}, and {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}}, but is also rendered unable to declare {{tip|basic attacks}}, cast {{tip|abilities}}, use [[summoner spell]]s, and [[active ability items|activate items]].
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 400
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = True
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = Area of effect
|notes        = 
* ''Icathian Surprise's'' {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} increases by {{as|{{ap|(50-10)/16}}% |ms}} every {{rutngt|0.25}} over the duration, up to the maximum of {{as|50%|ms}}. However, as a result of the ticks being rounded up from {{fd|0.25}} seconds, the movement speed only reaches up to {{as|{{ap|10+((50-10)/16)*14}}%|ms}}.
* ''Icathian Surprise's'' {{tip|untargetability}} does not {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroy}} in-flight {{tip|projectiles}}.
* ''Icathian Surprise'' will still trigger if '''Kog'Maw''' is killed by the {{tip|Nexus Obelisk}}.
* If '''Kog'Maw''' has the missile from a basic attack in-flight at the same time that he's moving while he dies, as long as the missile hits the target after ''Icathian Surprise'' has started, '''Kog'Maw''' will be able to use a basic attack once during ''Icathian Surprise''.
* '''Kog'Maw's''' usable [[summoner spell]]s will be placed on a 5 second cooldown upon becoming a zombie.
* During ''Icathian Surprise'', '''Kog'Maw's''' {{as|{{sti|attack range}}}} is reduced{{ft|to 0|by 500}}, making him automatically path near enemies he is trying to target.
{{Zombie state info}}
}}
